messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync: kicking off Nova Systems co-host onboarding. Target announce week: 2026-04-12. Need owners for legal addendum, marketplace assets, and SI staging.

Sam (Legal): I can own the addendum. Need the upstream license, partner contact, and any export-control notes. Will draft by Tue if I get materials.

Diego (Product): We'll need three artifacts: server container, float16 weights, ggml-quantized. Also a small manifest + perf numbers (p50/p95 on H100). I can produce the manifest by Fri.

Rachel (Marketplace): Listing needs: marketing blurb, logo, 2 inference traces/screenshots, pricing guidance. I need assets by Wed to hit the announce window. We'll stage the listing as embargoed.

Owen (SolutionsEng): SI checklist: helm values, run_smoke.sh, registry creds for staging. I can deploy Wed/Thu once I have the image. Confirm whether downloads are Redwood-hosted S3 or partner-hosted.

Maya (Partnerships): Proposal: staggered publish — hosted API first, downloads 48-72 hrs after signatures. Thoughts?

Sam (Legal): Staggered is safer. I'll add a fallback-routing clause for quantized variants (partner must sign off).

Rachel (Marketplace): Staggered works. I'll set publish_time and keep downloads hidden until legal clears.

Owen (SolutionsEng): Please provide registry creds + sample values.yaml by EOD Tue.

Diego (Product): Sending manifest + perf matrix by Fri EOD.

Maya (Partnerships): Great — I'll assemble a single doc linking Sam's draft, Diego's manifest, and the staging URL. Tag me if blockers.
